blocking_reason: No authoritative window: zero window.lock.json anywhere in the repository; four conflicting research_state.json on unmerged P0 branches (Windows9/10/11/12); zero Stage 3 survivors exist on any ref (all ideas_master.jsonl empty, no stage3_prior_work.md). Do-not-guess rule prevents selecting a WindowsN.

wave_a_attack_templates.note: Templates only. NOT runnable until P0 emits one authoritative WindowsN/_state/window.lock.json + research_state.json and Stages 1-3 produce ~50 Stage 3 survivors in <windows_path>/_state/ideas_master.jsonl. On the unblocked re-run, the batch planner will instantiate one task per attacker role per batch of survivors, filling idea_ids from actual survivor records. No attacks are run by the planner.

rules: attacks only - no Keep/Kill verdicts (verdicts belong to a later wave)
no fabricated citations: cite only verifiable sources or mark evidence_or_citation_or_none as 'none'

roles.mandate: For each survivor idea in the batch, produce the strongest good-faith rejection case: novelty deflation vs known prior work, overclaiming, weak framing, unfalsifiable claims, 'so what' failures.

For each survivor idea in the batch, attack feasibility and rigor: experimental design flaws, missing baselines/controls, confounds, data availability, statistical power, compute/scale realism, reproducibility.
For each survivor idea in the batch, attack impact: marginal-gain critique, niche audience, dead-end trajectory, better-served-by-existing-methods, real-world irrelevance.

batching_policy.expected_survivors: ~50 (actual count read from ideas_master.jsonl at re-run)
batching_policy.parallelism: all Wave A attack tasks are independent and may run in parallel
